99ebd031e99b.title: Skills it satisfies
99ebd031e99b.content: A skill states the capability; this Tool is one way to exercise it. Each skill’s declared input and output contract follows, where it has one. lean-proof-vacuity-audit . Detect and fix Lean “vacuous proof” anti-patterns — declarations that type-check, are sorry-free and axiom-clean, and whose statement matches the .md, yet carry NO mathematical content (they assume what they claim, conclude something trivially true, or rest on a false premise). These slip past proof-statement-integrity (which only checks signature-stability + an axiom sweep), so detection is semantic and agent-checked. Use when auditing Lean for circular / vacuous / trivially-true proofs, after a batch proof-statement-integrity normalization (the batch “wrap the conclusion in a structure field and project it” fix produces these), or when a “theorem” looks too easy. Emits per-block QA sidecar params under the proof-no-* criteria. Source: folio-assistant-sci/skills/content/folio-paper-adapter/lean-proof-vacuity-audit.md. The skill declares no I/O contract (schemas/skills/lean-proof-vacuity-audit/{input,output}.schema.json).

c0a9a532ae6c.title: Tools
c0a9a532ae6c.content: As an API: OpenAPI document · MCP tool list · API reference. A skill states a capability generically: what an actor needs to know to perform a task. A Tool is one concrete way to exercise it, with an installation, an invocation and typed inputs and outputs. One skill may be satisfied by several tools, and one tool may satisfy several skills. They are separate graphs and this is the tools one. The relation between them is satisfies, and it runs from a tool to a skill — this tool is one way to do that, never this skill is a tool. 304Tool nodes 130skills satisfied 271invoked as a shell command 34reachable over MCP

c9d352312fb3.doc: Ingestion subprocess — build the L1 knowledge graph
c9d352312fb3.title: Steps
c9d352312fb3.content: Every one of the 7 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Write dublin-core.jsonld (the record of truth)Task_Dublin | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | One standalone Dublin Core record per folder. dcterms is already this corpus’s JSON-LD vocabulary, so this extends a live context rather than introducing one. | . | Write manifest.jsonld referencing itTask_Manifest | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Write manifest.jsonld for the folder: its @id, @type folio:SourceDocument, what it contains and its provenance, referencing the standalone dublin-core.jsonld as the record of truth rather than copying its fields. | . | Record assets[] — local path or remote URLTask_Assets | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | kind / role / url-or-path / checksum / retrieved. A SIBLING of library:, never inside it: LibraryRef is regenerated from the tree, so an authored URL placed there is dropped on the next sync. | . | Bind the folder to its bibliography slugTask_Bind | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Bind the folder name to the document’s bibliography slug, so library/<bib-slug>/ and its citation key are the same string: a citation resolves to a directory without a lookup table between them. | . | Read glossary into candidate termsTask_Glossary | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | glossary-terms | The source’s glossary and abbreviations sections become candidate terms of a folio-glossary/v1 scheme with the Tool glossary-from-source, verbatim, each with source file#line, and an acronym as the notation of the term it expands. Terms a person owns are never changed, and only a person moves a term to authored. A source with no such section skips this step with nothing written. | . | Extract reference listsTask_References | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | l1-document-ingestion | Each reference list of the source (a References, Bibliography or Further reading section, in any of the six UN languages) becomes folio-reference/v1 nodes with the Tool references-extract: one node per cited work, provenance extracted, derivedFrom the section it was read from, and printed the entry exactly as the source prints it. Only fields read without guessing are set (address, DOI, ISBN, year, access date); a cited IRIS item the library holds gets heldAt. The nodes are the document’s own bibliography on the bibliography page. A source with no reference list skips this step with nothing written. | . | Link L1 nodes into the corpus graphTask_Link | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Anything in library/ is L1 source content. A knowledge-graph reference from any artefact – paper, L2, L3 – resolves to it through library/. | .

3c749f2c2990.doc: Ingestion subprocess — derive content from the assets
3c749f2c2990.title: Steps
3c749f2c2990.content: Every one of the 8 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Archive → greppable contents manifestTask_Archive | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | NOT IMPLEMENTED; see docs/document-ingestion.md. Mechanical and cheap; the checksum is what makes a remote asset verifiable. | . | Narrative description per image, localizedTask_Image | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Applies equally to an image EXTRACTED FROM A PDF (Task_FiguresTables), not only to an uploaded one. An agent opens every image and vector render and records a verdict in the library’s image-verdicts.json: role (figure, logo or decorative), the reason, and a draft description in English plus ar, zh, es, fr and ru, which the apply-image-verdicts.ts arm lays over images.json on every ingest. Images judged figure are kept as WebP, quality 80, at most 1600 px; logos, decorative fragments and page scans are not. Every description stays a draft until a person confirms it with bun run cat narratives. Method: skill document-intake, “Figures and captioned tables: describe, keep, transcribe”. | . | Transcribe and translate audioTask_Audio | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | No Tool yet; the method, and the choice of recogniser, is skill audio-transcription. | . | Sheet names, headers, shape, narrativeTask_Tabular | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Tools tabular-csv and tabular-xlsx, as CSVW (skill tabular-metadata). CSV and spreadsheet: tabs, column and row headers, sizes, and what the dataset is about. | . | Extract figures and tablesTask_FiguresTables | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | The pdf-images.py, pdf-vector-labels.py and pdf-vector-figures.py arms extract the raster images and the figures drawn as vectors (grouped and rendered). For every table the document’s structure declares, an agent reads the rendered page, checks cell text against the text layer, and writes tables/<label>.csv plus tables.csvw.json (folio-tabular-csvw/v1), with a draft description in the six UN languages; pdf-tables.py’s grid is a cross-check, not the answer. Owner, 2026-11-11 (who-iris): “actually extract the figures” and “any tables too”. Method: skill document-intake, “Figures and captioned tables: describe, keep, transcribe”. | . | Footnotes and the marks that call themTask_Footnotes | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | l1-document-ingestion | The pdf-footnotes.py arm (owner, 2026-11-11, “also foot notes/marks”): from the page layout, each note at the foot of a page and every superscript mark in the text that calls it, written to footnotes.json (folio-document-footnotes/v1) with the block that holds the page. The section text is not changed. Only a called note is a footnote; uncalled foot-of-page lines and marks with no note are listed, never dropped. OCR’d pages have no fonts and are reported unread. Method: skill l1-document-ingestion, “Footnotes and their marks”. | . | Cite the author of every narrativeTask_Provenance | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | A generated description is a claim by someone. Record whether a human or an agent wrote it, and for an agent the model version. An uncited narrative is indistinguishable from a transcription of the source. | .

78e4c076dc79.title: Steps
78e4c076dc79.content: Every one of the 6 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Extract the text layerTask_ExtractText | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | The document has a text layer: extract it with pdf-extract (pdfminer.six, then a zero-dependency content-stream reader). Exit 2 means no text layer — a scan — and routes to OCR; it is not an empty document. | . | Check each page; OCR pages that failTask_PageCheck | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | l1-document-ingestion | Owner, 2026-11-11 (who-iris, card Q-ODD-1 = A): “force OCR when a page’s text layer fails a quality check”. A text layer can hold plenty of letters and still not be the page’s text: accents mapped to Greek letters (“dΘclaration”), Persian set in the wrong Arabic code points, words split by kerning (“au g m ente”), fake-bold words printed twice, mojibake. cat-harness-tools scripts/_text_quality.py checks every page against the document’s languages (dc.language.iso, or –lang-hint); the router then OCRs the document and pdf-structure.py –ocr takes the OCR text for the failing pages only, listing them in structure.json source.ocr_pages with the reason. When most pages of a document with no outline fail, the whole document is read from OCR, as for a scan. Method: skill l1-document-ingestion, “A text layer that is not text”. | . | OCR to ocr/page-*.txtTask_Ocr | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Each page is read in the document’s languages (–lang-hint, from dc.language.iso), narrowed to the script the page shows. A page Tesseract is unsure of (mean word confidence under 70) is read again with each other installed script added, and the most confident read is kept: a French article’s Arabic abstract, or the Latin URLs in an Arabic document’s references. A document ingested this way keeps its text in ocr/ and only a stub in sections/, which the documented sections/ grep cannot see. That asymmetry is why the corpus-grep checklist has a fourth tier. The run also records WHICH SOFTWARE made the pages, in ocr/run-context.json: a folio-run-context/v1 (cat-harness schemas/run-context.ts, the record test runs and QA reports use for the same question), naming the OCR engine, the rasteriser and each language model with its version and the sha256 of the bytes that ran. Two OCRs of one scan can read differently (“Manual” and “Manval”), and without it neither could be told from the other or reproduced. | . | Split into sections/*.md with doc_brief front-matterTask_Sections | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Contextual retrieval: a chunk in isolation loses what makes it mean anything, so each section carries the document brief. An outline is set aside when its entries are machine bookmark names (_GoBack, _Hlk…, “Blank Page”, a merged file’s name) or when under half of them name a heading the pages print, and the contents are inferred instead (diagnostics.outline_rejected). A section that would hold more than half of a document of 20 pages or more (and over 8,000 words), or over 20,000 words anywhere, is cut at the headings inferred inside it, else one section per page (diagnostics.oversized_split). Owner, 2026-11-11: “split single blocks that hold a whole book”. Method: skill l1-document-ingestion, “An outline that is not contents, and a section too long to be a block”. | . | Write structure.jsonTask_Structure | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Write structure.json (pdf-structure/v1): doc id, TOC from the PDF outline or inferred from headings, page ranges, metadata, and source{} with the sha256 and a mimetype sniffed from the bytes, never the extension. A structure that could not be determined says so in structure_note rather than being rendered as one. For OCR’d text, source.runContext cites the OCR step’s run context by sha256. A title already known for the document (the catalogue’s dc.title, or one given with –title) is passed through as the raw title, so the sections’ doc_title does not carry a scan’s misreading. | . | Extract claim candidatesTask_Candidates | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | candidates.json holds extracted theorems and definitions. Proposals only – never adjudicated verdicts. | .

776232c16443.title: Steps
776232c16443.content: Every one of the 4 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Is every derived artefact present?Task_CheckDerived | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | L1 source to L1 KG is NOT complete while a required derived artefact is missing. This is the gate that makes the derivation steps obligatory rather than aspirational. | . | Round-trip translation QATask_RoundTrip | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | translation-manageruntainted-verification | Back-translate each localized narrative into its source language and compare the meaning, to catch semantic drift and bad terminology that a forward-only check cannot see. Agentic. Two parties are kept apart under untainted-verification: a back-translator that sees ONLY the target-language text, and an adjudicator that sees the original and the back-translation and rules. The verdict is recorded per block, under criterion translation-semantic-roundtrip in the block’s <block>.<locale>.translation-qa.json sidecar, by the translation-roundtrip-record Tool (translation-manager §5). A terminology miss is a different criterion, translation-terms-preserved (acronyms, numbers, URLs that must survive), so Gateway_Drift can tell the two apart. Never close this step by reversing the PO’s msgid→msgstr map: that returns the source exactly and scores 1.0 always. An empty translation-semantic-roundtrip entry list means “not yet run”, which is never a pass. | . | Adjudicate the flagged passageTask_FlagDrift | Reviewer (SME or editor) | calls Adjudicationdocument-intakeadjudication | A machine can detect that two readings differ. Which one is right is a human call. | . | Record the L1 completeness verdictTask_Verdict | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | document-intake | Record the completeness verdict in three states — met, unmet, or not yet derivable — as bun run cat check:l1-complete reports it. Not-yet-derivable is never a pass. An unmet verdict opens a bean and returns to derivation; only a met one lets the entry into library/. | .

7d98ee34b144.title: Decisions

The same shape criterion-adjudication uses, where three outcomes converge on one write because what makes an outcome legitimate is that its reason was recorded.What differs is what gets written and what it obliges. real is drift to fix in the translation. spurious is a false positive, and recording it is what stops the same passage being re-flagged every run. source-wrong points at the SOURCE rather than the translation — the one answer that sends work out of this process entirely, because no amount of re-translating a wrong source produces a right target. | the drift is real → Record the L1 completeness verdictfalse positive → Record the L1 completeness verdictthe SOURCE is wrong → Record the L1 completeness verdict | .

1569bb99ecb7.title: Steps
1569bb99ecb7.content: Every one of the 5 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Read the served stylesheet’s declarationsTask_ReadStylesheet | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | theme-art-intake | Read the ROLE, never the prettiest value. Bootstrap’s –blue is a scale entry and –primary is the role; DSpace sets them differently, and taking the brand-looking one is the hardcoding schemas/ui/theme.ts exists to end. Column widths come from declared columns, never from breakpoints: a breakpoint is a viewport. | . | Read the guide’s own stated rulesTask_ReadGuide | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | theme-art-intake | From the INGESTED document’s sections, not from a screenshot and not inferred from a site that happens to use the brand. A palette per kind would be three spellings of “accent colour”, free to disagree about what an accent IS. Where the source is SILENT on a role, say so and mark the value a choice rather than dressing an invention as a measurement. | . | Record contradictions IN the sourceTask_Contradictions | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | theme-art-intake | A step because sources do contradict themselves (one colour given two values on different pages). A contradiction silently resolved is indistinguishable from one nobody noticed, so it is kept as data and the reading taken is stated as a choice. | . | Theme and UI reviewTask_Review | Ingestion Engine (agent, runs unattended) | calls Theme and UI review — at ingestiontheme-ui-review | THEME REVIEW HAPPENS HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE: graphical assets are reviewed at ingestion, in the context of the website or app design they are for.So this step CALLS theme-ui-review.bpmn.WHAT THE CALL COSTS, stated rather than hidden. The subprocess has a human step, R_Judge: a person looks at the ingested assets laid out in their design at a web and a mobile width. So ingesting a THEME SOURCE is attended at that step. Ingesting anything else stays unattended: it never reaches this subprocess.THE AUTOMATED CHECK IS INSIDE THE CALL. “A theme sets the stripe’s hue; it never sets its width to zero” — colour alone carrying a whole signal fails WCAG SC 1.4.1, and the WHO guide agrees (“Never red with green, never blue with yellow”). That check is A_Accessibility in the called process, which measures contrast against the real ground and requires a non-colour channel wherever colour carries meaning. | .

f54991edfd39.title: Every initialization step, as the declarations name them
f54991edfd39.content: Skill initialization-steps: Walk every initialization step the declarations name (the layer’s own and each one it needs), check each before doing anything, do what can be done, ask for what only a person can do, and report every step as done, not done, could not determine, or stated. Named by: Complete initialization, Determine the harness and repositories, Initialize a harness . You are making sure a harness’s initialization is complete: right after installing it (initialize-harness calls complete-initialization), or because you were dispatched to do exactly this with nothing but the diagram and the repository. Either way the steps are the same, and they are not listed in this file. They are named by the declarations.

754d02497db7.title: Where the steps come from
754d02497db7.content: Read <name>.json at the root, then each name in its needs, from a sibling checkout at ../<name>/<name>.json. Each step below names the declaration that names it, so a reader can see why it is there. | step | named by | done when | . | declaration | the file itself | <name>.json parses and its name is its file name | . | needs:<name> | needs | the dependency is beside it, and its declaration parses | . | instructions:<name> | FR-4 | stated: <name>/docs/bootstrap/initialization.md was read and followed | . | schemas:staged | each $id / @id under iriBase (FR-11) | the site build stages every JSON Schema and JSON-LD document at its IRI | . | schemas:published | the same IRIs (FR-11) | every one of those IRIs answers | . | directory:<id> | directories[] | the declared path exists | . | asset:<id> | assets[] | the declared file exists | . | readme | FR-8 | the root has a README.md | . | readme-sections | the README’s own markers | every section the README opts into is current | . | site:workflow | repository | a workflow commits the rendered site onto gh-pages | . | site:branch | repository | a gh-pages branch exists — it must, before Pages can be switched on | . | site:enabled | repository | Pages is on, serving gh-pages | . | site:live | iriBase, else the Pages address | the address answers | . The two schemas: steps are the primary ones. They are checked first once the declarations are read, and the report leads with them: publish-documents. A harness above bootstrap names more steps the same way. A work-plan store it declares as a directory is a directory: step, and a harness’s own set-up instructions are its instructions: step. Bootstrap does not need to know which harness declares what. The site steps are in publish-site.

562776a73f9b.title: Four states, not two
562776a73f9b.content: . | done: checked, and it holds. | not done: checked, and it does not. Say exactly what to do next. | could not determine: the check could not run (no forge CLI, no network). Never reported as done. A check that could not look is not a pass. | stated: the declarations name it but nothing can observe it (reading and following a harness’s instructions). Follow it, say you did, and leave it stated. | .

b0b572aaf9f6.title: Idempotent by construction
b0b572aaf9f6.content: Check before doing, every time. A done step is left alone, so running the process twice changes nothing the second time, and an interrupted run is resumed by running it again. Performing is not the same as done: after you do a step, check it again, and only the check says done. Replace nothing. A step that would overwrite what somebody wrote (an existing README, a Pages site built from a branch, a declaration that disagrees with the directories on disk) is a step for the person. Ask through human-agent-discussion, with the exact step written out. Do not create an empty declared directory to make its step pass. Git does not track an empty directory, so the check would pass on your machine and fail on every clone. Put its first file in it, or ask whether the entry should go.

448e85a8a993.title: Where tools are available
448e85a8a993.content: A toolset may perform the checks for you — for example https://github.com/litlfred/bootstrap-tools, whose init command reads the same declarations, does what a tool can (regenerating README sections; switching Pages on when an authenticated gh is present), and prints each step in these four states with what to do next: . bun run scripts/init.ts --root ../<instance> # from a toolset checkout beside it bun run scripts/init.ts --root ../<instance> --dry-run # check only . Where no tools are available, do the same by reading files. The diagram is the same either way, and so is the report.

d1af0ba834e7.title: The report
d1af0ba834e7.content: One report through log-message, led by the primary step’s state (the JSON Schemas and JSON-LD at their IRIs): then every step, the declaration that named it, its state, what was seen, and for anything not done, what to do and who does it. End with the counts (done, not done, could not determine, stated). An initialization that finished with steps open says which. It is not hidden behind “installed”.

b96b3b419bd3.title: Initialize a harness
b96b3b419bd3.content: Process_InitializeHarness · strict (defaulted) · 8 step(s) . THE ONLY PROCESS IN BOOTSTRAP AN ACTOR STARTS. A Bootstrapping Agent that has read bootstrap’s README.md is at its start event and has nowhere else to begin. Every other diagram here is reached from this one by a call activity and is never started: discussion determines which harness and where; human-agent-discussion is the one reusable way any diagram asks a person anything; complete-initialization makes sure every step the declarations name is done; log-message records what a step is doing. PRECONDITIONS are DECLARED below as bootstrap.processes:precondition elements rather than asserted here. Three of the four are kind=”stated”: nothing in this repository can observe whether an actor understands what a role is, so they evaluate to could-not-determine, never to satisfied. The fourth is checkable: README.md EXISTS. That the Bootstrapping Agent read it is not observable. NO work-plan element on any activity: a work plan is harness machinery and a Bootstrapping Agent runs before the harness that carries it. isExecutable is false because the engine that runs a diagram is harness machinery too — this is data a Bootstrapping Agent reads, not a process bootstrap can drive. i i i i i i i i

245cf27e7c31.title: Steps
245cf27e7c31.content: Every one of the 8 step(s) is documented. | step | lane | skill / sub-process | what it does | . | Determine which harness, and whereA_DetermineHarness | Bootstrapping Agent | calls Determine the harness and repositoriesconfirm-harness | The candidates are listed and the Requestor is asked, in discussion, which asks through human-agent-discussion. IN: nothing but the context this agent was handed. OUT: zero or ONE harness, and the locations — a document conforming to discussion.output.schema.json. One at most: a list of two is not an answer, and the Bootstrapping Agent may not break the tie itself. | . | Read what each location already isA_ReadLocation | Bootstrapping Agent | bootstrap-kg-navigation | Ask the location, not your memory of it: a Knowledge Graph Data Store that carries a declaration at its root is ALREADY a layer, and it says so itself. <name>.json present and parsing is the whole test, and bootstrap-kg-navigation says what the three answers mean — absent (not a layer yet), present, and present-but-unreadable, which is a layer asserting something broken and is not a green light either.Done before reading the chosen harness: a location held by another harness ends the process here. | . | Read the harness’s declaration and instructionsA_ReadDeclaration | Bootstrapping Agent | bootstrap-kg-navigation | Performed against the data store — a git repository, through the git CLI or a forge API. The instructions are at a PREDETERMINED spot on the harness: <name>/docs/bootstrap/initialization.md, the same for every harness, which is what lets a Bootstrapping Agent be pointed at one nobody has written yet. | . | Log the start of the installA_LogInstallStart | Bootstrapping Agent | calls Log a messagelog-message | REQUIRED logging, which is what drawing the call says. Logged before anything is written, so an install interrupted halfway is distinguishable from one never begun. | . | Follow them, at each locationA_Install | Bootstrapping Agent | bootstrap-kg-navigation | The instructions belong to the harness being installed, not to bootstrap — bootstrap does not know what any Harness above it requires, and does not need to. | . | Write the root README, if it is not thereA_WriteRootReadme | Bootstrapping Agent | root-readme | The repository now IS a layer instantiating a harness, and nothing at its root says so. It carries a LINK to the harness that was installed and the OVERALL install status across every location — WHEN ABSENT, never replacing: where a README is already there, the link and status go in a marker pair the harness’s own README tool maintains.Initialization may create the README: the rule that a running process never writes an instance-readme governs a layer that already exists. | . | Make sure every step is doneA_CompleteInitialization | Bootstrapping Agent | calls Complete initializationinitialization-steps | Following a harness’s instructions once is not the same as every step being done. complete-initialization walks the steps the declarations name — FIRST the harness’s JSON Schemas and JSON-LD at the IRIs they name, the primary step of initializing a Knowledge Graph harness; then declared directories, assets, the README and its sections, and the site that carries the documents — checks each, does what can be done, asks the person for what only they can do, and reports every step in its state. An agent may be dispatched to run it on its own: it needs nothing but that diagram and the declarations. | . | Log the failureA_LogFailure | Bootstrapping Agent | calls Log a messagelog-message | Every failure path passes through here, so “logged as failed” is a step somebody performs rather than an adjective on an end event. What differs between the ways in is the message, which is an input, not the mechanism. | .

d1fe301afa6d.title: Предварительные требования
d1fe301afa6d.content: folio-assistant работает на Bun и подключается к LLM-агенту через MCP. Самой платформе требуется только Bun; отдельные типы контента подтягивают более тяжелые наборы инструментов (LaTeX, Lean, FHIR IG Publisher), которые проверяются во время выполнения и могут быть установлены по требованию. | Требование | Для чего требуется | Установка (Linux/macOS) | Установка (Windows) | . | Bun ≥ 1.0 | фреймворк (всегда) | curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install \| bash | winget install Oven-sh.Bun | . | Git + git-lfs | репозитории контента | apt install git git-lfs | winget install Git.Git GitHub.GitLFS | . | LaTeX (latexmk, texlive) | рендеринг статей | apt install texlive-full latexmk biber | winget install MiKTeX.MiKTeX | . | Lean 4 (через elan) | формализация статей | curl …/elan-init.sh \| sh -s -- -y | см. релизы elan | . | Java 21 + IG Publisher + SUSHI | WHO SMART IG (L3) | см. руководство по WHO SMART IG | winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK, затем руководство | . | pandoc, ripgrep | преобразования, поиск | apt install pandoc ripgrep | winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | . Обязателен только Bun. Каждая остальная строка относится к конкретному типу контента и проверяется во время выполнения, поэтому ничего другого устанавливать не нужно, пока об этом не попросит check-deps.

16f1765c3d58.title: Клонирование и установка
16f1765c3d58.content: git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant bun install . Для Windows есть скрипт . На чистой машине, где установлен только git-клиент, этот скрипт устанавливает Bun (через winget, если доступен), обновляет PATH, выполняет bun install и затем передает управление проверке возможностей: . git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -CheckOnly # только отчет, ничего не устанавливает .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 # выполнить установку . Он устанавливает Bun и ничего больше — LaTeX, Lean, Java и IG Publisher остаются привязкой к конкретным типам контента и сообщаются check-deps с подсказками по установке. Шелл-скрипты платформы написаны для bash. В Windows они выполняются в Git Bash, который устанавливается вместе с Git for Windows, поэтому git — единственное дополнительное предварительное требование. Рядом с каждым скриптом, который пользователь запускает вручную или прописывает в конфигурации, находится файл .bat — cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\start-folio-assistant.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\git-hooks\install.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\session-start-coord-sweep.bat и так далее. Этот файл находит Git Bash (ни в коем случае не лаунчер WSL в System32) и запускает соседний .sh с теми же аргументами. Используйте их из cmd.exe, PowerShell, Task Scheduler или параметров конфигурации MCP: . cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat cat-harness-tools\scripts\upload-to-uploads.bat https://example.org/guideline.pdf . Все, что требуется скриптам .sh — bun, curl, gh, elan — должно быть доступно в Windows PATH, поскольку Git Bash наследует его от вызывающего процесса. Скрипты, которые имеют смысл только на хосте Linux (deploy/, install-tex.sh, setup-sage.sh, setup-singular.sh), намеренно не имеют bat-оберток. Их список находится в cat-harness-tools/scripts/gen-bat-wrappers.sh; команда bun run cat bat:sync заново генерирует обертки, а bun run cat bat:sync:check завершает CI с ошибкой, если какая-либо из них отсутствует или устарела. Для Linux/macOS также есть скрипт . cat-harness-tools/scripts/start-folio-assistant.sh устанавливает Bun, если он отсутствует, а затем запускает сервер, а cat-harness-tools/adapters/mcp-server/install.sh представляет собой более полный установщик, охватывающий также и TeX Live.

d618c5bbb0f3.title: Проверка окружения
d618c5bbb0f3.content: Проверка --check-deps сообщает, какие возможности присутствуют в системе, и дает подсказку по установке для всего, что отсутствует: . bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --check-deps # или через npm-скрипт bun run cat check-deps .

f82dd050573f.title: Запуск сервера
f82dd050573f.content: folio-assistant — это MCP-сервер. Он поддерживает два вида транспорта: . # транспорт stdio — то, что запускают LLM-харнессы (Claude Code и др.) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio # транспорт HTTP — для долгоживущего общего инстанса / веб-интерфейса bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --http # указать репозиторий контента, над которым вы работаете (по умолчанию ../.. ) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo /path/to/your/content-repo . В package.json есть удобные скрипты: . bun run cat start # по умолчанию (stdio) bun run cat start:http # транспорт HTTP bun run test # модульные тесты (bun test) bun run cat test:e2e # сквозные (e2e) тесты Playwright bun run cat lint # eslint .

1921ba8a976c.title: Настройка под ваше фолио
1921ba8a976c.content: Скопируйте пример конфигурации в свой репозиторий контента (не в folio-assistant) и настройте его под ваш тип контента: . # ЦЕЛЕВОЙ ФАЙЛ именуется по названию вашего инстанса -- `my-folio.config.json`, а не # фиксированным словом. Пример файла сохраняет собственное имя: именно так он называется. cp cat-harness/docs/reference/harness.config.example.json /path/to/your/content-repo/<your-name>.config.json . { "contentType": "document", "adapter": "document", "adapterModule": "./folio-assistant/adapters/document/index.ts", "feedbackDir": ".folio-feedback", "skills": ".claude/skills/local" } . Параметр contentType выбирает как адаптер, так и профиль типов блоков. Используйте "paper" (и adapters/paper/index.ts) для фолио с математическими утверждениями, подкрепленными Lean, — адаптер paper расширяет адаптер document, поэтому он также предоставляет все инструменты для документов. Инструмент folio_init создает этот файл за вас; см. Создание нового фолио.

4cc3360a7c4d.title: Подключение LLM-харнесса
4cc3360a7c4d.content: folio-assistant предоставляет свои инструменты через MCP, поэтому им может управлять любой харнесс агентов с поддержкой MCP. Ниже приведены конфигурации для распространенных харнессов. Во всех случаях агент запускает сервер через stdio. Claude Code . Добавьте folio-assistant в качестве MCP-сервера. Конфигурация уровня проекта хранится в .mcp.json в корне вашего репозитория контента: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Либо зарегистрируйте его через CLI: . claude mcp add folio-assistant -- bun run /path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo . Claude Code также нативно считывает AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md и учитывает хук SessionStart в .claude/settings.json — таким образом, прайминг плана работы запускается автоматически при старте сессии. Antigravity . Antigravity нативно считывает AGENTS.md, поддерживает MCP-серверы и хук жизненного цикла SessionStart. Добавьте сервер в его конфигурацию MCP (формат JSON, общий с Gemini CLI): . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Подключите прайминг при старте сессии к хуку SessionStart в Antigravity, чтобы каждая сессия получала прайминг плана работы: укажите в команде хука общий скрипт cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh (тот же самый скрипт, который используют все харнессы; у каждого инструмента отличается только формат конфигурации хука). Gemini CLI . Gemini CLI нативно считывает AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md. Зарегистрируйте MCP-сервер в его настройках и используйте тот же скрипт SessionStart: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Любой другой MCP-клиент . Направьте ваш клиент на указанную выше команду stdio или запустите транспорт HTTP (bun run cat start:http) и подключитесь по протоколу HTTP. MCP-сервер предоставляет инструмент work_plan_prime, который может вызвать любой подключенный по MCP агент для получения идентичного актуального прайминга плана работы независимо от используемого харнесса. Почему это работает во всех харнессах. Регламент зафиксирован в AGENTS.md (стандарт для агентов от Linux Foundation, нативно считываемый Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot и другими); актуальное состояние предоставляется как через отдельный для каждого харнесса хук SessionStart поверх единого общего скрипта, так и через MCP-инструмент work_plan_prime. См. страницу архитектуры.

7dd392db292b.title: Installation
7dd392db292b.content: . | Prérequis | Cloner et installer . | Sur Windows, il existe un script | Sur Linux/macOS, il existe également un script | . | Vérifier votre environnement | Lancer le serveur | Configurer pour votre folio | Connecter un harnais LLM . | Claude Code | Antigravity | Gemini CLI | Tout autre client MCP | . | . Ce qu’il faut exécuter avant de pousser (push), c’est platform-gates ; la réussite de bun test ne garantit pas le passage des « gates », car leur liste est dérivée du workflow de CI. Si vous intégrez folio-assistant sur un dépôt déjà existant, lisez d’abord repo-conversion.

ce528d385c22.title: Prérequis
ce528d385c22.content: folio-assistant s’exécute sur Bun et se connecte à un agent LLM via MCP. La plateforme elle-même n’a besoin que de Bun ; les types de contenu individuels font appel à des chaînes d’outils plus lourdes (LaTeX, Lean, le FHIR IG Publisher) qui sont vérifiées au moment de l’exécution et peuvent être installées à la demande. | Prérequis | Nécessaire pour | Installation (Linux/macOS) | Installation (Windows) | . | Bun ≥ 1.0 | le framework (toujours) | curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install \| bash | winget install Oven-sh.Bun | . | Git + git-lfs | dépôts de contenu | apt install git git-lfs | winget install Git.Git GitHub.GitLFS | . | LaTeX (latexmk, texlive) | rendu des articles | apt install texlive-full latexmk biber | winget install MiKTeX.MiKTeX | . | Lean 4 (via elan) | formalisation des articles | curl …/elan-init.sh \| sh -s -- -y | voir les versions d’elan | . | Java 21 + IG Publisher + SUSHI | IGs WHO SMART (L3) | voir le guide WHO SMART IG | winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK, puis le guide | . | pandoc, ripgrep | conversions, recherche | apt install pandoc ripgrep | winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | . Seul Bun est requis. Chaque autre ligne est spécifique au type de contenu et fait l’objet d’une sonde au moment de l’exécution ; n’installez donc rien d’autre tant que check-deps ne le demande pas.

4c512a85e689.title: Cloner et installer
4c512a85e689.content: git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant bun install . Sur Windows, il existe un script . Sur une machine vierge disposant uniquement d’un client git, ceci installe Bun (via winget si disponible), actualise la variable PATH, exécute bun install, puis passe le relais à la sonde de capacités : . git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -CheckOnly # rapport uniquement, n'installe rien .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 # exécuter l'installation . Il installe Bun et rien d’autre — LaTeX, Lean, Java et l’IG Publisher restent propres à chaque type de contenu, signalés par check-deps avec des indications d’installation. Les scripts shell de la plateforme sont en bash. Sur Windows, ils s’exécutent sous Git Bash, que Git pour Windows installe, git est donc le seul prérequis supplémentaire. Chaque script qu’un utilisateur exécute manuellement ou intègre dans une configuration dispose d’un .bat à ses côtés — cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\start-folio-assistant.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\git-hooks\install.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\session-start-coord-sweep.bat, etc. — qui localise Git Bash (jamais le lanceur WSL dans System32) et exécute le script .sh jumeau avec les mêmes arguments. Utilisez-les depuis cmd.exe, PowerShell, le Planificateur de tâches ou une entrée de configuration MCP : . cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat cat-harness-tools\scripts\upload-to-uploads.bat https://example.org/guideline.pdf . Tout ce dont le script .sh a besoin — bun, curl, gh, elan — doit se trouver dans le PATH de Windows, puisque Git Bash en hérite depuis l’appelant. Les scripts qui n’ont de sens que sur un hôte Linux (deploy/, install-tex.sh, setup-sage.sh, setup-singular.sh) n’ont délibérément aucun wrapper. La liste se trouve dans cat-harness-tools/scripts/gen-bat-wrappers.sh ; bun run cat bat:sync régénère les wrappers et bun run cat bat:sync:check fait échouer la CI si l’un d’eux est manquant ou obsolète. Sur Linux/macOS, il existe également un script . cat-harness-tools/scripts/start-folio-assistant.sh installe Bun s’il est manquant et démarre ensuite le serveur, et cat-harness-tools/adapters/mcp-server/install.sh est un installateur plus complet couvrant également TeX Live.

b785a1522acc.title: Vérifier votre environnement
b785a1522acc.content: La sonde --check-deps signale quelles capacités sont présentes et fournit une indication d’installation pour tout élément manquant : . bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --check-deps # ou via le script npm bun run cat check-deps .

25e68abd9bac.title: Lancer le serveur
25e68abd9bac.content: folio-assistant est un serveur MCP. Il prend en charge deux modes de transport : . # transport stdio — ce que les harnais LLM (Claude Code, etc.) lancent bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio # transport HTTP — pour une instance partagée de longue durée / l'interface web bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --http # pointez-le vers le dépôt de contenu que vous rédigez (valeur par défaut : ../.. ) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo /path/to/your/content-repo . Des scripts pratiques sont disponibles dans package.json : . bun run cat start # par défaut (stdio) bun run cat start:http # transport HTTP bun run test # tests unitaires (bun test) bun run cat test:e2e # tests de bout en bout Playwright bun run cat lint # eslint .

01768425f82e.title: Configurer pour votre folio
01768425f82e.content: Copiez l’exemple de configuration dans votre dépôt de contenu (pas dans folio-assistant) et ajustez-le selon votre type de contenu : . # La DESTINATION est nommée d'après votre instance -- `mon-folio.config.json`, pas un # mot fixe. Le fichier d'exemple conserve son propre nom : c'est ainsi qu'il s'appelle. cp cat-harness/docs/reference/harness.config.example.json /path/to/your/content-repo/<votre-nom>.config.json . { "contentType": "document", "adapter": "document", "adapterModule": "./folio-assistant/adapters/document/index.ts", "feedbackDir": ".folio-feedback", "skills": ".claude/skills/local" } . contentType sélectionne à la fois l’adaptateur et le profil de types de blocs. Utilisez "paper" (et adapters/paper/index.ts) pour un folio comportant des mathématiques appuyées par Lean — l’adaptateur paper étend celui de document, il offre donc également chaque outil de document. folio_init écrit ce fichier pour vous ; voir Démarrer un nouveau folio.

c36a3c316248.title: Connecter un harnais LLM
c36a3c316248.content: folio-assistant expose ses outils via MCP, de sorte que tout harnais d’agent compatible MCP peut le piloter. Vous trouverez ci-dessous les configurations pour les plus courants. Dans tous les cas, l’agent lance le serveur via stdio. Claude Code . Ajoutez folio-assistant en tant que serveur MCP. La configuration propre au projet réside dans .mcp.json à la racine de votre dépôt de contenu : . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Ou enregistrez-le depuis la ligne de commande (CLI) : . claude mcp add folio-assistant -- bun run /path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo . Claude Code lit également nativement AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md et respecte le hook SessionStart dans .claude/settings.json — ainsi, l’amorceur du plan de travail s’exécute automatiquement au démarrage d’une session. Antigravity . Antigravity lit nativement AGENTS.md et prend en charge les serveurs MCP ainsi qu’un hook de cycle de vie SessionStart. Ajoutez le serveur à sa configuration MCP (format JSON partagé avec Gemini CLI) : . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Reliez l’amorceur de démarrage de session au hook SessionStart d’Antigravity afin que chaque session soit initialisée avec le plan de travail — faites pointer la commande du hook vers le script partagé cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh (le même script utilisé par chaque harnais ; seul le format de configuration du hook diffère selon l’outil). Gemini CLI . Gemini CLI lit nativement AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md. Enregistrez le serveur MCP dans ses paramètres et réutilisez le même script SessionStart : . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Tout autre client MCP . Pointez votre client vers la commande stdio ci-dessus, ou exécutez le transport HTTP (bun run cat start:http) et connectez-vous via HTTP. Le serveur MCP expose un outil work_plan_prime que tout agent connecté via MCP peut appeler pour obtenir une amorce du plan de travail en direct identique, quel que soit le harnais. Pourquoi cela fonctionne d’un harnais à l’autre. La discipline réside dans AGENTS.md (un standard pour agents de la Linux Foundation lu nativement par Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot et d’autres) ; l’état en direct est exposé à la fois sous la forme d’un hook SessionStart propre à chaque harnais via un script partagé et sous la forme de l’outil MCP work_plan_prime. Consultez la page architecture.

34c2455b5b81.title: التثبيت
34c2455b5b81.content: . | المتطلبات الأساسية | الاستنساخ والتثبيت . | على Windows، يوجد برنامج نصي | على Linux/macOS، يوجد أيضًا برنامج نصي | . | فحص بيئتك | تشغيل الخادم | التكوين لـ folio الخاص بك | توصيل إطار LLM . | Claude Code | Antigravity | Gemini CLI | أي عميل MCP آخر | . | . ما يجب تشغيله قبل أن تدفع (push) هو platform-gates؛ فاجتياز bun test ليس هو اجتياز البوابات. وإذا كنت تضع folio-assistant فوق مستودع موجود بالفعل، فاقرأ repo-conversion أولاً.

7f7f0a3a3418.title: المتطلبات الأساسية
7f7f0a3a3418.content: يعمل folio-assistant على Bun ويتصل بوكيل نموذج لغوي كبير (LLM) عبر MCP. والمنصة نفسها لا تحتاج إلا إلى Bun؛ أما أنواع المحتوى الفردية فتتطلب مجموعات أدوات أثقل (LaTeX وLean وFHIR IG Publisher) التي يتم التحقق منها في وقت التشغيل ويمكن تثبيتها عند الطلب. | المتطلب | مطلوب لـ | التثبيت (Linux/macOS) | التثبيت (Windows) | . | Bun ≥ 1.0 | إطار العمل (دائمًا) | curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install \| bash | winget install Oven-sh.Bun | . | Git + git-lfs | مستودعات المحتوى | apt install git git-lfs | winget install Git.Git GitHub.GitLFS | . | LaTeX (latexmk، وtexlive) | تصيير الأوراق العلمية | apt install texlive-full latexmk biber | winget install MiKTeX.MiKTeX | . | Lean 4 (عبر elan) | الصياغة الرياضية الرسمية للأوراق | curl …/elan-init.sh \| sh -s -- -y | راجع إصدارات elan | . | Java 21 + IG Publisher + SUSHI | أدلة تطبيق WHO SMART (المستوى L3) | راجع دليل WHO SMART IG | winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK، ثم الدليل | . | pandoc، وripgrep | التحويلات، والبحث | apt install pandoc ripgrep | winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | . Bun هو المطلوب فقط. كل صف آخر يخص نوع محتوى معين ويتم فحصه في وقت التشغيل، لذا لا تثبّت أي شيء آخر حتى يطلبه check-deps.

c43d2d904113.title: الاستنساخ والتثبيت
c43d2d904113.content: git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant bun install . على Windows، يوجد برنامج نصي . من جهاز مجرد لا يحتوي إلا على عميل git، يقوم هذا البرنامج بتثبيت Bun (عبر winget حيثما يتوفر)، ويحدّث PATH، ويشغل bun install، ثم يسلّم المهمة إلى فاحص القدرات: . git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -CheckOnly # report only, installs nothing .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 # do it . وهو يثبت Bun ولا شيء غيره — وتبقى أدوات LaTeX وLean وJava وIG Publisher لكل نوع محتوى، ويُبلغ عنها check-deps مع تلميحات التثبيت. البرامج النصية للمنصة مكتوبة بلغة bash. وعلى نظام Windows، تعمل هذه البرامج تحت Git Bash، الذي يقوم Git for Windows بتثبيته، لذا فإن git هو المتطلب الإضافي الوحيد. وكل برنامج نصي يشغله المستخدم يدويًا أو يربطه في تكوين ما، يوجد ملف .bat بجانبه — مثل cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat، وcat-harness-tools\scripts\start-folio-assistant.bat، وcat-harness-tools\scripts\git-hooks\install.bat، وcat-harness-tools\scripts\session-start-coord-sweep.bat وما إلى ذلك — حيث يعثر على Git Bash (ولا يستخدم أبدًا مشغّل WSL الموجود في System32) ويشغّل البرنامج النصي الشقيق .sh بنفس المعاملات. استخدم هذه الملفات من cmd.exe أو PowerShell أو Task Scheduler أو عنصر تكوين MCP: . cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat cat-harness-tools\scripts\upload-to-uploads.bat https://example.org/guideline.pdf . أي شيء يحتاجه ملف .sh — مثل bun وcurl وgh وelan — يجب أن يكون موجودًا في PATH الخاص بنظام Windows، نظرًا لأن Git Bash يرثه من برنامج الاستدعاء. والبرامج النصية التي لا معنى لها إلا على بيئة استضافة Linux (deploy/، وinstall-tex.sh، وsetup-sage.sh، وsetup-singular.sh) لا تحتوي على مغلّف عن قصد. وتوجد القائمة في cat-harness-tools/scripts/gen-bat-wrappers.sh؛ ويقوم bun run cat bat:sync بإعادة إنشاء المغلّفات، بينما يتسبب bun run cat bat:sync:check في إفشال CI إذا كان أي منها مفقودًا أو قديمًا. على Linux/macOS، يوجد أيضًا برنامج نصي . يقوم cat-harness-tools/scripts/start-folio-assistant.sh بتثبيت Bun إذا كان مفقودًا ثم يبدأ تشغيل الخادم، كما أن cat-harness-tools/adapters/mcp-server/install.sh هو برنامج تثبيت أكثر شمولاً يغطي TeX Live أيضًا.

4374227b870c.title: فحص بيئتك
4374227b870c.content: يُبلغ فاحص --check-deps عن القدرات الموجودة ويقدم تلميح تثبيت لأي شيء مفقود: . bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --check-deps # or via the npm script bun run cat check-deps .

24eb13c89b7b.title: تشغيل الخادم
24eb13c89b7b.content: إن folio-assistant هو خادم MCP. وهو يدعم وسيطي نقل: . # stdio transport — what LLM harnesses (Claude Code, etc.) launch bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio # HTTP transport — for a long-running shared instance / the web UI bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --http # point it at the content repo you are authoring (defaults to ../.. ) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo /path/to/your/content-repo . توجد برامج نصية للملاءمة في package.json: . bun run cat start # default (stdio) bun run cat start:http # HTTP transport bun run test # unit tests (bun test) bun run cat test:e2e # Playwright end-to-end tests bun run cat lint # eslint .

189e32386bd8.title: التكوين لـ folio الخاص بك
189e32386bd8.content: انسخ نموذج التكوين إلى مستودع المحتوى الخاص بك (وليس إلى folio-assistant) واضبطه وفقًا لنوع المحتوى لديك: . # The DESTINATION is named for your instance -- `my-folio.config.json`, not a # fixed word. The example file keeps its own name: that is what it is called. cp cat-harness/docs/reference/harness.config.example.json /path/to/your/content-repo/<your-name>.config.json . { "contentType": "document", "adapter": "document", "adapterModule": "./folio-assistant/adapters/document/index.ts", "feedbackDir": ".folio-feedback", "skills": ".claude/skills/local" } . يحدد contentType كلاً من المحول وملف تعريف نوع الكتلة. استخدم "paper" (وadapters/paper/index.ts) لـ folio يحتوي على رياضيات مدعومة بـ Lean — حيث يوسع محول paper محول document، وبالتالي يوفر جميع أدوات document أيضًا. يكتب folio_init هذا الملف نيابة عنك؛ راجع بدء folio جديد.

de81452f49ce.title: توصيل إطار LLM
de81452f49ce.content: يعرض folio-assistant أدواته عبر MCP، لذا يمكن لأي إطار عمل وكيل يدعم MCP تشغيله. فيما يلي تكوينات للأطر الشائعة. في كل الحالات، يشغّل الوكيل الخادم عبر stdio. Claude Code . أضف folio-assistant كخادم MCP. يوجد التكوين على نطاق المشروع في ملف .mcp.json في جذر مستودع المحتوى الخاص بك: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . أو سجّله من واجهة سطر الأوامر (CLI): . claude mcp add folio-assistant -- bun run /path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo . يقرأ Claude Code أيضًا AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md بشكل أصيل ويلتزم بخطاف SessionStart في .claude/settings.json — بحيث يعمل ممهّد خطة العمل تلقائيًا عند بدء الجلسة. Antigravity . يقرأ Antigravity ملف AGENTS.md بشكل أصيل ويدعم خوادم MCP وخطاف دورة الحياة SessionStart. أضف الخادم إلى تكوين MCP الخاص به (تنسيق JSON مشترك مع Gemini CLI): . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . قم بربط ممهّد بدء الجلسة بخطاف SessionStart في Antigravity حتى تُمهَّد كل جلسة بخطة العمل — وجّه أمر الخطاف إلى البرنامج النصي المشترك cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh (وهو البرنامج النصي نفسه الذي يستخدمه كل إطار؛ ويختلف فقط تنسيق تكوين الخطاف باختلاف الأداة). Gemini CLI . يقرأ Gemini CLI ملف AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md بشكل أصيل. سجّل خادم MCP في إعداداته وأعد استخدام البرنامج النصي نفسه لـ SessionStart: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . أي عميل MCP آخر . وجّه عميلك إلى أمر stdio أعلاه، أو شغّل وسيط نقل HTTP (bun run cat start:http) واتصل عبر HTTP. يتيح خادم MCP أداة work_plan_prime التي يمكن لأي وكيل متصل بـ MCP استدعاؤها للحصول على تمهيد مباشر ومتطابق لخطة العمل، بغض النظر عن إطار العمل المستخدم. لماذا يعمل هذا عبر الأطر المختلفة. نقطة الدخول هي AGENTS.md (وهو معيار لوكلاء Linux Foundation يُقرأ بشكل أصيل بواسطة Claude Code وGemini CLI وAntigravity وCursor وCopilot وغيرها)، ويحيل إلى المهارات حيث يكمن الانضباط؛ ويتم إظهار الحالة المباشرة كخطاف SessionStart لكل إطار عبر برنامج نصي مشترك، وكأداة MCP المسماة work_plan_prime. راجع صفحة البنية الهندسية.

170103e1a470.title: Instalación
170103e1a470.content: . | Requisitos previos | Clonar e instalar . | En Windows, existe un script | En Linux/macOS, también existe un script | . | Verifica tu entorno | Ejecutar el servidor | Configurar para tu folio | Conectar un arnés de LLM . | Claude Code | Antigravity | Gemini CLI | Cualquier otro cliente MCP | . | . Lo que debes ejecutar antes de hacer push es platform-gates; que bun test pase no significa que los gates hayan pasado. Si estás incorporando folio-assistant sobre un repositorio que ya existe, lee primero repo-conversion.

0095b5e3c2ce.title: Requisitos previos
0095b5e3c2ce.content: folio-assistant se ejecuta sobre Bun y se conecta a un agente LLM a través de MCP. La plataforma en sí solo necesita Bun; los tipos de contenido individuales incorporan cadenas de herramientas más pesadas (LaTeX, Lean, el FHIR IG Publisher) que se verifican en tiempo de ejecución y se pueden instalar bajo demanda. | Requisito | Necesario para | Instalación (Linux/macOS) | Instalación (Windows) | . | Bun ≥ 1.0 | el marco de trabajo (siempre) | curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install \| bash | winget install Oven-sh.Bun | . | Git + git-lfs | repositorios de contenido | apt install git git-lfs | winget install Git.Git GitHub.GitLFS | . | LaTeX (latexmk, texlive) | renderizado de artículos | apt install texlive-full latexmk biber | winget install MiKTeX.MiKTeX | . | Lean 4 (mediante elan) | formalización de artículos | curl …/elan-init.sh \| sh -s -- -y | consulta las versiones de elan | . | Java 21 + IG Publisher + SUSHI | IGs SMART de la OMS (L3) | consulta la guía de IG SMART de la OMS | winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK, luego la guía | . | pandoc, ripgrep | conversiones, búsqueda | apt install pandoc ripgrep | winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | . Solo se requiere Bun. Cada una de las demás filas depende del tipo de contenido y se comprueba en tiempo de ejecución, por lo que no instales nada más hasta que check-deps lo solicite.

4b80b32afa9c.title: Clonar e instalar
4b80b32afa9c.content: git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant bun install . En Windows, existe un script . En una máquina limpia que solo cuenta con un cliente git, este script instala Bun (a través de winget donde esté disponible), actualiza el PATH, ejecuta bun install y luego da paso a la comprobación de capacidades: . git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -CheckOnly # solo reporte, no instala nada .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 # ejecutarlo . Instala Bun y nada más — LaTeX, Lean, Java y el IG Publisher se mantienen por tipo de contenido, reportados por check-deps con sugerencias de instalación. Los scripts de shell de la plataforma son bash. En Windows se ejecutan bajo Git Bash, el cual es instalado por Git para Windows, por lo que git es el único prerrequisito adicional. Cada script que un usuario ejecuta manualmente o conecta a una configuración tiene un .bat a su lado — cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\start-folio-assistant.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\git-hooks\install.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\session-start-coord-sweep.bat y así sucesivamente —, el cual localiza Git Bash (nunca el iniciador de WSL en System32) y ejecuta el .sh hermano con los mismos argumentos. Utilízalos desde cmd.exe, PowerShell, el Programador de tareas o una entrada de configuración de MCP: . cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat cat-harness-tools\scripts\upload-to-uploads.bat https://example.org/guideline.pdf . Cualquier cosa que necesite el archivo .sh — bun, curl, gh, elan — debe estar en el PATH de Windows, ya que Git Bash lo hereda del proceso que lo llama. Los scripts que solo tienen sentido en un host Linux (deploy/, install-tex.sh, setup-sage.sh, setup-singular.sh) no tienen wrapper a propósito. La lista reside en cat-harness-tools/scripts/gen-bat-wrappers.sh; bun run cat bat:sync regenera los wrappers y bun run cat bat:sync:check hace fallar la CI si falta alguno o está desactualizado. En Linux/macOS, también existe un script . cat-harness-tools/scripts/start-folio-assistant.sh instala Bun si no está presente y luego inicia el servidor, y cat-harness-tools/adapters/mcp-server/install.sh es un instalador más completo que cubre también TeX Live.

bed4d1769537.title: Verifica tu entorno
bed4d1769537.content: La comprobación con --check-deps informa qué capacidades están presentes y proporciona una sugerencia de instalación para cualquier elemento faltante: . bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --check-deps # o a través del script de npm bun run cat check-deps .

3961a2b128d3.title: Ejecutar el servidor
3961a2b128d3.content: folio-assistant es un servidor MCP. Admite dos transportes: . # transporte stdio — lo que inician los arneses de LLM (Claude Code, etc.) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio # transporte HTTP — para una instancia compartida de larga duración / la interfaz web bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --http # apúntalo al repositorio de contenido que estés redactando (por defecto ../.. ) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo /path/to/your/content-repo . Hay scripts de conveniencia en package.json: . bun run cat start # predeterminado (stdio) bun run cat start:http # transporte HTTP bun run test # pruebas unitarias (bun test) bun run cat test:e2e # pruebas de extremo a extremo con Playwright bun run cat lint # eslint .

369ca69f5484.title: Configurar para tu folio
369ca69f5484.content: Copia la configuración de ejemplo en tu repositorio de contenido (no en folio-assistant) y ajústala para tu tipo de contenido: . # El DESTINO se nombra según tu instancia -- `my-folio.config.json`, no una # palabra fija. El archivo de ejemplo conserva su propio nombre: así es como se llama. cp cat-harness/docs/reference/harness.config.example.json /path/to/your/content-repo/<your-name>.config.json . { "contentType": "document", "adapter": "document", "adapterModule": "./folio-assistant/adapters/document/index.ts", "feedbackDir": ".folio-feedback", "skills": ".claude/skills/local" } . contentType selecciona tanto el adaptador como el perfil de tipo de bloque. Utiliza "paper" (y adapters/paper/index.ts) para un folio con matemáticas respaldadas por Lean — el adaptador paper amplía el de document, por lo que también ofrece todas las herramientas de document. folio_init escribe este archivo por ti; consulta Iniciar un nuevo folio.

ced7f9173ae6.title: Conectar un arnés de LLM
ced7f9173ae6.content: folio-assistant expone sus herramientas a través de MCP, por lo que cualquier arnés de agente compatible con MCP puede controlarlo. A continuación se presentan las configuraciones para los más comunes. En todos los casos, el agente inicia el servidor mediante stdio. Claude Code . Agrega folio-assistant como un servidor MCP. La configuración con ámbito de proyecto se encuentra en .mcp.json en la raíz de tu repositorio de contenido: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . O regístralo desde la CLI: . claude mcp add folio-assistant -- bun run /path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo . Claude Code también lee AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md de forma nativa y respeta el hook SessionStart en .claude/settings.json — de modo que la preparación del plan de trabajo se ejecuta automáticamente cuando inicia una sesión. Antigravity . Antigravity lee AGENTS.md de forma nativa y admite servidores MCP y un hook de ciclo de vida SessionStart. Agrega el servidor a su configuración de MCP (formato JSON compartido con Gemini CLI): . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Conecta la preparación de inicio de sesión al hook SessionStart de Antigravity para que cada sesión se prepare con el plan de trabajo — apunta el comando del hook al script compartido cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh (el mismo script que utilizan todos los arneses; solo el formato de configuración del hook varía según la herramienta). Gemini CLI . Gemini CLI lee AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md de forma nativa. Registra el servidor MCP en su configuración y reutiliza el mismo script SessionStart: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Cualquier otro cliente MCP . Apunta tu cliente al comando stdio anterior, o ejecuta el transporte HTTP (bun run cat start:http) y conéctate a través de HTTP. El servidor MCP expone una herramienta work_plan_prime que cualquier agente conectado por MCP puede invocar para obtener una preparación idéntica del plan de trabajo en tiempo real, independientemente del arnés. Por qué funciona en diferentes arneses. El punto de entrada es AGENTS.md (un estándar de agentes de la Linux Foundation leído de forma nativa por Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot y otros), que remite a los skills donde reside la disciplina; el estado en tiempo real se expone tanto como un hook SessionStart específico de cada arnés a través de un script compartido, como mediante la herramienta MCP work_plan_prime. Consulta la página de arquitectura.

36c8cae4a19a.title: 安装
36c8cae4a19a.content: . | 前置要求 | 克隆与安装 . | 在 Windows 上，有一个脚本 | 在 Linux/macOS 上，也有一个脚本 | . | 检查你的环境 | 运行服务器 | 为你的 folio 进行配置 | 连接 LLM harness . | Claude Code | Antigravity | Gemini CLI | 任何其他 MCP 客户端 | . | . 在推送之前需要运行的是 platform-gates； bun test 通过并不代表关卡通过，因为关卡列表是从 CI 工作流中派生出来的。如果你是在已有仓库之上搭建 folio-assistant，请先阅读 repo-conversion。 .

9f8122070a64.title: 前置要求
9f8122070a64.content: folio-assistant 运行在 Bun 之上，并通过 MCP 连接到 LLM 智能体。平台本身仅需要 Bun；具体的内容类型会引入更重的工具链（LaTeX、Lean、FHIR IG Publisher），这些工具链会在运行时进行检查，并可按需安装。 . | 依赖项 | 用途 | 安装（Linux/macOS） | 安装（Windows） | . | Bun ≥ 1.0 | 框架（始终必需） | curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install \| bash | winget install Oven-sh.Bun | . | Git + git-lfs | 内容仓库 | apt install git git-lfs | winget install Git.Git GitHub.GitLFS | . | LaTeX (latexmk, texlive) | 渲染论文 | apt install texlive-full latexmk biber | winget install MiKTeX.MiKTeX | . | Lean 4 (via elan) | 形式化论文 | curl …/elan-init.sh \| sh -s -- -y | 参见 elan 发布页面 | . | Java 21 + IG Publisher + SUSHI | WHO SMART IG（L3） | 参见 WHO SMART IG 指南 | winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK，然后参见指南 | . | pandoc, ripgrep | 转换、搜索 | apt install pandoc ripgrep | winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | . 你不需要安装上述所有工具——只需安装你所创作的内容类型所需要的工具。内置的能力探测工具会告知你缺少什么。 . 只有 Bun 是必需的。 其他各行都属于特定内容类型并在运行时进行探测，因此在 check-deps 提示之前无需安装任何其他工具。 .

713311d7affa.title: 克隆与安装
713311d7affa.content: git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant bun install . 在 Windows 上，有一个脚本 . 在一台仅装有 git 客户端的干净机器上，该脚本会安装 Bun（在可用时通过 winget）、刷新 PATH、运行 bun install，然后移交给能力探测工具： . git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -CheckOnly # 仅报告，不安装任何内容 .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 # 执行安装 . 它仅安装 Bun，而不安装其他任何内容——LaTeX、Lean、Java 和 IG Publisher 仍然按内容类型区分，由 check-deps 报告并附带安装提示。 . 该平台的 shell 脚本均为 bash。在 Windows 上，它们在 Git Bash 下运行，Git for Windows 会安装 Git Bash，因此 git 是唯一的额外前置要求。用户手动运行或接入配置的每个脚本旁边都有一个对应的 .bat 文件——例如 cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat、cat-harness-tools\scripts\start-folio-assistant.bat、cat-harness-tools\scripts\git-hooks\install.bat、cat-harness-tools\scripts\session-start-coord-sweep.bat 等——它会寻找 Git Bash（绝不会使用 System32 中的 WSL 启动器）并以相同的参数运行同级 .sh 脚本。你可以从 cmd.exe、PowerShell、任务计划程序（Task Scheduler）或 MCP 配置条目中使用它们： . cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat cat-harness-tools\scripts\upload-to-uploads.bat https://example.org/guideline.pdf .sh 所需的任何工具——bun、curl、gh、elan——都必须位于 Windows 的 PATH 中，因为 Git Bash 会从调用方继承环境变量。特意未为仅在 Linux 主机上有意义的脚本（deploy/、install-tex.sh、setup-sage.sh、setup-singular.sh）提供包装器。脚本列表维护在 cat-harness-tools/scripts/gen-bat-wrappers.sh 中；bun run cat bat:sync 会重新生成这些包装器，如果缺少或过期，bun run cat bat:sync:check 会导致 CI 失败。 . 在 Linux/macOS 上，也有一个脚本 . cat-harness-tools/scripts/start-folio-assistant.sh 会在 Bun 缺失时自动安装，然后启动服务器；cat-harness-tools/adapters/mcp-server/install.sh 是一个更完整的安装程序，同时也涵盖了 TeX Live。 .

eba8fa205e11.title: 检查你的环境
eba8fa205e11.content: --check-deps 探测会报告当前具备哪些能力，并为缺失的任何组件提供安装提示： . bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --check-deps # 或通过 npm 脚本 bun run cat check-deps .

35e599f533fb.title: 运行服务器
35e599f533fb.content: folio-assistant 是一个 MCP 服务器。它支持两种传输协议： . # stdio 传输 —— LLM harness（Claude Code 等）所启动的协议 bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio # HTTP 传输 —— 适用于长期运行的共享实例 / Web UI bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --http # 将其指向你正在创作的内容仓库（默认为 ../.. ） bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo /path/to/your/content-repo . package.json 中提供了便捷脚本： . bun run cat start # 默认（stdio） bun run cat start:http # HTTP 传输 bun run test # 单元测试（bun test） bun run cat test:e2e # Playwright 端到端测试 bun run cat lint # eslint .

4228ef2441d9.title: 为你的 folio 进行配置
4228ef2441d9.content: 将示例配置复制到你的内容仓库中（而不是复制到 folio-assistant 中），并根据你的内容类型进行调整： . # 目标文件名以你的实例命名 —— 例如 `my-folio.config.json`，而不是一个固定单词。 # 示例文件保留其自身名称：这就是它的称谓。 cp cat-harness/docs/reference/harness.config.example.json /path/to/your/content-repo/<your-name>.config.json . { "contentType": "document", "adapter": "document", "adapterModule": "./folio-assistant/adapters/document/index.ts", "feedbackDir": ".folio-feedback", "skills": ".claude/skills/local" } . contentType 同时选择了适配器和块类型配置文件（profile）。对于包含由 Lean 提供支持的数学内容的 folio，请使用 "paper"（以及 adapters/paper/index.ts）——paper 适配器扩展了 document 适配器，因此它也提供所有 document 工具。folio_init 会替你编写该文件；参见启动一个新 folio。 .

062286124deb.title: 连接 LLM harness
062286124deb.content: folio-assistant 通过 MCP 暴露其工具，因此任何支持 MCP 的智能体 harness 都可以驱动它。以下是常见 harness 的配置。在所有情况下，智能体都通过 stdio 启动服务器。 . Claude Code . 将 folio-assistant 添加为 MCP 服务器。项目级配置位于内容仓库根目录下的 .mcp.json 中： . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . 或者从 CLI 注册： . claude mcp add folio-assistant -- bun run /path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo . Claude Code 也会原生读取 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 并响应 .claude/settings.json 中的 SessionStart 钩子 —— 这样当会话启动时，工作计划启动引导（work-plan primer）就会自动运行。 . Antigravity . Antigravity 原生读取 AGENTS.md，并支持 MCP 服务器和 SessionStart 生命周期钩子。将服务器添加到其 MCP 配置中（与 Gemini CLI 共享的 JSON 格式）： . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . 将会话启动引导挂接到 Antigravity 的 SessionStart 钩子，以便每个会话在启动时都载入工作计划 —— 将钩子命令指向共享脚本 cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh（所有 harness 都使用同一个脚本；仅每个工具的钩子配置格式有所不同）。 . Gemini CLI . Gemini CLI 原生读取 AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md。在其设置中注册该 MCP 服务器并复用相同的 SessionStart 脚本： . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . 任何其他 MCP 客户端 . 将你的客户端指向上述 stdio 命令，或者运行 HTTP 传输（bun run cat start:http）并通过 HTTP 连接。MCP 服务器暴露了一个 work_plan_prime 工具，任何已连接 MCP 的智能体都可以调用它以获取相同的实时工作计划引导，无论使用何种 harness。 . 为什么这能在不同 harness 之间通用。 规程存在于 AGENTS.md 中（这是一个由 Linux 基金会制定的智能体标准，可被 Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Cursor、Copilot 等原生读取）；实时状态既通过单个共享脚本作为针对不同 harness 的 SessionStart 钩子暴露，也作为 work_plan_prime MCP 工具暴露。参见架构页面。 .

fe4995ce5ca7.title: Prerequisites
fe4995ce5ca7.content: folio-assistant runs on Bun and connects to an LLM agent over MCP. The platform itself only needs Bun; individual content types pull in heavier toolchains (LaTeX, Lean, the FHIR IG Publisher) which are checked at runtime and can be installed on demand. | Requirement | Needed for | Install (Linux/macOS) | Install (Windows) | . | Bun ≥ 1.0 | the framework (always) | curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install \| bash | winget install Oven-sh.Bun | . | Git + git-lfs | content repositories | apt install git git-lfs | winget install Git.Git GitHub.GitLFS | . | LaTeX (latexmk, texlive) | rendering papers | apt install texlive-full latexmk biber | winget install MiKTeX.MiKTeX | . | Lean 4 (via elan) | formalizing papers | curl …/elan-init.sh \| sh -s -- -y | see elan releases | . | Java 21 + IG Publisher + SUSHI | WHO SMART IGs (L3) | see WHO SMART IG guide | winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK, then the guide | . | pandoc, ripgrep | conversions, search | apt install pandoc ripgrep | winget install JohnMacFarlane.Pandoc BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | . Only Bun is required. Every other row is per content type and is probed at runtime, so install nothing else until check-deps asks for it.

d13fff89103e.title: Clone and install
d13fff89103e.content: git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant bun install . On Windows, there is a script . From a bare machine with only a git client, this installs Bun (via winget where available), refreshes PATH, runs bun install, and then hands over to the capability probe: . git clone https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant.git cd folio-assistant .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -CheckOnly # report only, installs nothing .\cat-harness-tools\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 # do it . It installs Bun and nothing else — LaTeX, Lean, Java and the IG Publisher stay per content type, reported by check-deps with install hints. The platform’s shell scripts are bash. On Windows they run under Git Bash, which Git for Windows installs, so git is the only extra prerequisite. Every script a user runs by hand or wires into a config has a .bat beside it — cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\start-folio-assistant.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\git-hooks\install.bat, cat-harness-tools\scripts\session-start-coord-sweep.bat and so on — which finds Git Bash (never the WSL launcher in System32) and runs the sibling .sh with the same arguments. Use them from cmd.exe, PowerShell, Task Scheduler or an MCP config entry: . cat-harness-tools\scripts\install-beans.bat cat-harness-tools\scripts\upload-to-uploads.bat https://example.org/guideline.pdf . Anything the .sh needs — bun, curl, gh, elan — must be on the Windows PATH, since Git Bash inherits it from the caller. Scripts that only make sense on a Linux host (deploy/, install-tex.sh, setup-sage.sh, setup-singular.sh) have no wrapper on purpose. The list lives in cat-harness-tools/scripts/gen-bat-wrappers.sh; bun run cat bat:sync regenerates the wrappers and bun run cat bat:sync:check fails CI if one is missing or stale. On Linux/macOS, there is also a script . cat-harness-tools/scripts/start-folio-assistant.sh installs Bun if it is missing and then starts the server, and cat-harness-tools/adapters/mcp-server/install.sh is a fuller installer covering TeX Live as well.

8a22fe15607e.title: Check your environment
8a22fe15607e.content: The --check-deps probe reports which capabilities are present and gives an install hint for anything missing: . bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --check-deps # or via the npm script bun run cat check-deps .

06bd9cfbbd26.title: Run the server
06bd9cfbbd26.content: folio-assistant is an MCP server. It speaks two transports: . # stdio transport — what LLM harnesses (Claude Code, etc.) launch bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio # HTTP transport — for a long-running shared instance / the web UI bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --http # point it at the content repo you are authoring (defaults to ../.. ) bun run cat-harness-tools/src/index.ts --stdio --repo /path/to/your/content-repo . There are convenience scripts in package.json: . bun run cat start # default (stdio) bun run cat start:http # HTTP transport bun run test # unit tests (bun test) bun run cat test:e2e # Playwright end-to-end tests bun run cat lint # eslint .

54ce8adc3737.title: Configure for your folio
54ce8adc3737.content: Copy the example config into your content repository (not into folio-assistant) and adjust it for your content type: . # The DESTINATION is named for your instance -- `my-folio.config.json`, not a # fixed word. The example file keeps its own name: that is what it is called. cp cat-harness/docs/reference/harness.config.example.json /path/to/your/content-repo/<your-name>.config.json . { "contentType": "document", "adapter": "document", "adapterModule": "./folio-assistant/adapters/document/index.ts", "feedbackDir": ".folio-feedback", "skills": ".claude/skills/local" } . contentType selects both the adapter and the block-kind profile. Use "paper" (and adapters/paper/index.ts) for a folio with Lean-backed mathematics — the paper adapter extends the document one, so it offers every document tool as well. folio_init writes this file for you; see Start a new folio.

6653ed5f4f1c.title: Connecting an LLM harness
6653ed5f4f1c.content: folio-assistant exposes its tools over MCP, so any MCP-capable agent harness can drive it. Below are configurations for the common ones. In every case the agent launches the server over stdio. Claude Code . Add folio-assistant as an MCP server. <tools-layer> below is the directory of the layer that implements this harness’s tools in your checkout. Project-scoped config lives in .mcp.json at the root of your content repo: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/<tools-layer>/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Or register it from the CLI: . claude mcp add folio-assistant -- bun run /path/to/folio-assistant/<tools-layer>/src/index.ts --stdio --repo . Claude Code also reads AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md natively and honours the SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json — so the work-plan primer runs automatically when a session starts. Antigravity . Antigravity reads AGENTS.md natively and supports MCP servers and a SessionStart lifecycle hook. Add the server to its MCP config (JSON format shared with Gemini CLI): . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/<tools-layer>/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Wire the session-start primer to Antigravity’s SessionStart hook so each session is primed with the work-plan — point the hook command at the shared script cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh (the same script every harness uses; only the hook-config format differs per tool). Gemini CLI . Gemini CLI reads AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md natively. Register the MCP server in its settings and reuse the same SessionStart script: . { "mcpServers": { "folio-assistant": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "/path/to/folio-assistant/<tools-layer>/src/index.ts", "--stdio", "--repo", "."] } } } . Any other MCP client . Point your client at the stdio command above, or run the HTTP transport (bun run cat start:http) and connect over HTTP. The MCP server exposes a work_plan_prime tool that any MCP-connected agent can call to get identical live work-plan priming, regardless of harness. Why this works across harnesses. The discipline lives in AGENTS.md (a Linux Foundation agent standard read natively by Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot, and others); the live state is exposed both as a per-harness SessionStart hook over one shared script and as the work_plan_prime MCP tool. See the architecture page.

474238b6d936.title: IRIS CDN initial load
474238b6d936.content: Process_IrisCdnInitialLoad · strict (defaulted) · 10 step(s) . The first full export of WHO IRIS onto Cloudflare (git on Artifacts, bytes in R2): every item record and every bitstream: metadata plus PDFs. Run in batches with a checkpoint, so a run that stops resumes where it stopped and never re-fetches what it already holds. Ends in one signed, verified release. i i i i i i i i i i

d21009ec3d89.doc: Sign and publish an IRIS CDN release
d21009ec3d89.title: Sign and publish an IRIS CDN release
d21009ec3d89.content: Process_IrisCdnSignPublish · strict (defaulted) · 8 step(s) . Turn a candidate payload into a signed release on Cloudflare: each changed library item gets a detached JWS over its own manifest, and the BagIt bag (RFC 8493) whose tagmanifest pins every item manifest and signature is signed once with a detached JWS (RFC 7515 Appendix F, ES256 per RFC 7518), the key published as a verificationMethod of a did:web DID document whose publicKeyJwk carries an x5c chain to the WHO signing key. Nothing unchanged is re-uploaded or re-signed; an empty diff ends the process with no commit. i i i i i i i i
